name: double_knell
notes: The bell rung twice: the knell with a second bronze front riding 6 px behind the first, shivering on the off-beat, and more chips. If the game spawns two knell fronts for this blow, use knell twice instead. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 36; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 56; place that point on the ring's position.
